core_obligations: (1) iff (2) by general properties of 1-morphisms of fibred categories.

(2) implies (3): W = (Sch/U) x_Y X is an algebraic stack by the fibre-product lemma; its objects are triples (V, x, alpha: y(V) -> f(x)); faithfulness of f makes the fibre categories setoids; the no-automorphisms proposition represents W by an algebraic space.
proof_roadmap: Level equivalence; criterion implication; setoid recognition via faithfulness.
difficulty_reason: The setoid recognition through the explicit triple description is the substantive step.
